versions.changelog:
- Expanded and updated reference guides: cfrs.md, check-ins.md, templates.md, and visualization.md.
- Improved coverage of Conversations, Feedback, Recognition (CFRs), weekly check-ins, OKR templates, and data visualization for OKRs.
- Enhanced quick reference coaching prompts and workshop guidance to support OKR facilitation and review.

Initial release of OKR Consulting Skill.

- Provides a comprehensive playbook for setting, tracking, reviewing, and optimizing OKRs (Objectives and Key Results).
- Includes guidance on OKR philosophy, scoring methods, antipatterns, and best practices for cadence management.
- Offers detailed workflow for OKR consultants: setting, monitoring, and retrospectives.
- Supplies coaching prompts, workshop facilitation guidance, and OKR dashboard design patterns.
- References notable sources and best-in-class OKR templates for practical application.
